statement.text: Suppose that G is a finite group, and $A_1,A_2,A_3$ are subsets of G such that the multiplication map $A_1\times A_2\times A_3\to G$ is bijective. Must the subgroup $\langle A_2\rangle$ generated by $A_2$ have order divisible by the cardinality $|A_2|$?
